description: This source file defines classes and enums related to managing web chat panels and windows for a macOS application, including the WebChatManager singleton class responsible for showing, toggling, and closing chat sessions and panels.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can become key and main, used for displaying web chat interfaces.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum representing how the web chat can be presented, either as a window or a panel with an anchor provider.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing chat window and panel sessions, including showing, toggling, and closing chat views.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the chat interface as a window for a given session key.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the chat panel anchored to a specific position.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the current chat panel if open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the preferred session key, using caching and fetching from GatewayConnection.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Resets all window and panel controllers and session keys.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all web chat sessions and panels.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles the event when the panel has been hidden, invoking the visibility change callback.
